note: Grounded in the Easy Form Builder 4.3.2 editor (BLD-01): a field's gear opens the docked "Edit Field" panel beside the form, the toolbar's "Form Settings" opens the form's panel; "Done" only closes a panel and the toolbar's Save stores the form. Every title, answer, step and feature label is translatable through includes/Efb/EfbKnowledgeStrings.php (php scripts/efb-knowledge-strings.php after an edit).

ui_pattern.open_field_settings: In the form editor, click the field to select it, then click the gear button (⚙) in the small toolbar on the field. The "Edit Field" panel opens beside the form, under the editor's toolbar (on a phone it opens over the form).
ui_pattern.open_form_settings: Click "Form Settings" in the editor's toolbar at the top. The "Form Settings" panel opens beside the form.
ui_pattern.save: When you are done, click "Done" at the top of the panel: it only closes the panel. Then click Save in the editor's toolbar at the top to store the form; until you do, the change is not stored.

entries.title: Make a field required
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and turn ON the "Required" toggle. Now the visitor must fill it in before submitting.

entries.title: Change a field's label / name
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and edit the "Label" (field name) box at the top of the panel. The label is the text shown above the field.

entries.title: Change the placeholder / example text
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and edit the "Placeholder" box. This is the light grey hint text shown inside the empty field.

entries.title: Change a field's width (put two side by side)
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and set the "Field width" (e.g. 50% for half). Two 50% fields sit next to each other; 100% is full width. On phones fields stack to full width automatically.

entries.title: Add or edit choices (dropdown / radio / checkbox options)
entries.answer: Select the choice field (dropdown/radio/checkbox/multi-select), open its settings (the gear on the field), and use the "Options" list to add, rename, reorder, or remove choices.

entries.title: Add help / message text under a field
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and fill the "Help" / "Message" text box. It appears as a small note beneath the field.

entries.title: Change a field's colors (label, text, border)
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and open the color controls (label color, input text color, border color). Pick a preset or a custom color for each.

entries.title: Change a field's height / corner style
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field); use the height option for the input height and the "corner" option to switch between square and rounded corners.

entries.title: Change the 'this field is required' error message
entries.answer: Select the field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and edit the custom required/validation message box, so visitors see your own wording when they skip the field.

entries.title: Set allowed file types and max upload size
entries.answer: Select the file field, open its settings (the gear on the field), and choose the file category (document, image, audio, video, spreadsheet, or all) and the maximum file size in MB.

entries.title: Delete or duplicate a field
entries.answer: Select the field to reveal its action buttons, then use the trash/delete button to remove it, or the copy/duplicate button to clone it. You can also drag a field to reorder it.

entries.title: Change the form title / name
entries.answer: Open the form/step settings (click the form header area), and edit the form name/title there.

entries.title: Change the thank-you / confirmation message
entries.answer: Open "Form Settings" in the editor's toolbar and find the "Thank you" / confirmation section; edit the message shown to the visitor after they submit.

entries.title: Turn on email notifications for submissions
entries.answer: Open "Form Settings" in the editor's toolbar and enable email notifications, then set the admin email address that should receive each new submission. (Email/SMTP must be configured in Easy Form Builder settings.) Since Easy Form Builder 4.3.2 the person who fills a NEW form gets a confirmation email at the form's first Email field by default (that field's "Enable email notifications" switch is on and it becomes the recipient); a second Email field stays off. Turn it off on the field if you do not want it; saved forms keep their own choice. When I design a new form I keep this default unless you ask for no confirmation, and in an open form you can tell me "turn off the confirmation email".

entries.title: Add captcha / spam protection
entries.answer: Easy Form Builder checks every form with a hidden honeypot and timing checks (soft spam checks) without any setup. For a CAPTCHA, set Google reCAPTCHA keys in Easy Form Builder → Settings → Captchas and choose the service per form in the form settings: Google reCAPTCHA v2 (checkbox), v2 invisible or v3 (score, with an optional v2 fallback) are part of every plan. Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, ALTCHA, Friendly Captcha and the question CAPTCHA are add-ons for Free Plus and Pro, each with its own settings screen. A form that asks for a service whose add-on is missing is protected by the site's Google CAPTCHA or the soft checks. I never enter CAPTCHA keys.

features.setting:captcha_provider: Choosing the CAPTCHA service per form

entries.title: Change the submit button text / color
entries.answer: Open "Form Settings" in the editor's toolbar and edit the submit button text and color (and Next/Previous button labels for multi-step forms).

entries.title: Split the form into multiple steps
entries.answer: Add a new Step from the elements/palette; drag fields into each step. Each step becomes a page with Next/Previous buttons. Edit a step's name or icon with the gear on the step. In the form settings, "Don't show icons & names of steps" and "Don't show progress bar" hide those rows; while a row is shown you can pick its style: steps as Classic, Circles, Pills or Chevrons, and the progress bar as Classic, Bar, Segments or Ring. I can change these on the open form too; nothing is stored until you click Save in the editor's toolbar.

entries.title: Show/hide fields with conditional logic
entries.answer: Open the form's Conditional Logic panel and create a rule: choose a field + condition (is / greater than / …) and an action (show, hide, require, jump to step, …). A field that a rule shows stays hidden until the rule matches. It needs the Conditional Logic add-on on Free Plus (up to 3 rules per form, 2 conditions each) or Pro (unlimited). With the add-on active you can also just tell me, e.g. "show Company name only when Customer type is Business", and I will add the rule for you to check and save. When a rule jumps forward to a later step, the steps it jumps over and every field in them become optional for that visitor: they are not checked, not required and not charged, so a skipped page never blocks Send.

entries.title: Embed the form on a page (shortcode)
entries.answer: Use the shortcode [EMS_Form_Builder id=FORM_ID] on any page or post (or the Easy Form Builder block/widget). AISAAutoPilot shows the exact shortcode right after it creates a form.

entries.title: Change the form background / general styles
entries.answer: Open "Form Settings" in the editor's toolbar for the general appearance options (background, label/element/message colors, fonts). Per-field colors are set in each field's own settings (the gear on the field).

entries.title: Input masks and validators (phone, postal code, national id)
entries.answer: Select a text, phone or postal field, open its settings and choose a mask preset (phone numbers, national ids, postal codes of many countries) or a custom mask; the visitor's digits in any script are accepted and checked again on the server. The postal-code presets (and the postcode-to-city lookup) come with the Address & Postal add-on, which installs on every plan.

entries.title: One-time codes for e-mail and mobile (OTP)
entries.answer: An Email field can ask the visitor to type the address twice (every plan) or confirm it with an e-mailed code (Free Plus). A Mobile field can require an SMS code: that is Pro and works only through Easy Form Builder's SMS add-on, which sends through the WP SMS plugin (the gateway and its keys are set up in WP SMS, never in the form). The visitor presses Send code on the page; an assistant never asks for or relays a code.

entries.title: Text rules: length, words, unique answers, allowed e-mail domains
entries.answer: In a field's settings you can set minimum / maximum characters or words with a live counter, a prefix or suffix, read-only, and where the error message shows. Free Plus and Pro add unique answers (one entry per value), a custom pattern, allowed or blocked e-mail domains, password strength and your own error messages. The server checks every rule again.

entries.title: Numbers, formats and calculations
entries.answer: Number formats (decimals, thousands separators, local digits, prefix / suffix), the two-handle slider, calculated fields with formulas and option values in formulas come with the Numbers & Calculations add-on (Free Plus). Using a calculation as the amount to pay is Pro. The server always recomputes every calculation; without the add-on a paid form whose amount comes from a calculation is refused (nothing is charged). When the add-on is missing I build a plain Number field and tell you what to install.

entries.title: Choices: stored values, shuffle, Other, Select all, limits, stock, ranking
entries.answer: Choice fields can store a value different from the label, shuffle their options, offer "Other" with a text box, "Select all", and minimum / maximum picks (every plan). Ranking is Free Plus. Stock per option and choices filled from posts, terms or users are Pro. Add options in bulk with "Add in bulk" in the field's settings.

entries.title: Advanced date field and calendars (Gregorian, Persian, Hijri)
entries.answer: The Date (advanced) field shows one calendar on every plan (Gregorian, Persian/Jalali, Hijri and others) with minimum / maximum dates and blocked weekdays. Several calendars with a switch, holidays, dates tied to another field, age limits and times are Free Plus; date ranges, several dates and opening hours per weekday are Pro. Availability and slots for bookings belong to the Booking add-on (Pro).

entries.title: File uploads: several files, camera, resizing, private storage
entries.answer: An upload field takes one file on every plan, can open the camera and can keep files private (reachable only through WordPress). Several files per field, image resizing and saving to the Media Library are Free Plus; attaching the files to the notification e-mail is Pro. A visitor's files are never uploaded by an assistant.

entries.title: Hidden fields, smart tags and URL prefill
entries.answer: A Hidden field stores a value the visitor does not see: a fixed text or a smart tag such as {get:utm_source}, {user:email}, {page:title} or {date:Y-m-d}; any field can be prefilled from the page address (?key=value). Showing an earlier answer inside a label is Free Plus. {geo:country} (the visitor's country from the IP) needs the Visitor Country add-on (Free Plus and Pro) with the site admin's own ipinfo.io or ip-api.com key.

entries.title: Repeater group (add another row)
entries.answer: A Repeater group lets the visitor add rows of the same fields (for example one row per guest). One row is Free Plus; several rows, rows counted from another answer and collapsible rows are Pro. Each row is checked on the server.

entries.title: Review page, sections, rich text, who sees a field, typed signature
entries.answer: A review page before Send and collapsible sections are on every plan. A rich-text answer box is Free Plus. Showing a field only to logged-in visitors or to some roles is Pro (a saved rule is enforced on every plan). Letting the visitor type the signature instead of drawing it needs the Typed Signature add-on (Free Plus); the drawn signature stays in Easy Form Builder.

entries.title: Answer limits, opening and closing dates, save and continue later
entries.answer: In the form settings, "Access and limits" sets a total number of answers, opening and closing dates (site time), a message when full or closed and, for private forms, allowed roles (every plan). Limits per person, IP, browser or e-mail and the popup button are Free Plus. Save and continue later and partial answers (with consent) are Pro.

entries.title: Privacy and data retention
entries.answer: Each form can follow the site's privacy settings or set its own: store, anonymize or drop the visitor's IP, delete entries after a number of days, or e-mail answers without storing them. Site-wide rules are in Easy Form Builder → Settings → Privacy (administrators only). All of it is on every plan.

entries.title: Reading and managing entries
entries.answer: Entries are read in Easy Form Builder → Panel under the form's messages: search, unread / starred / spam / trash tabs, columns and filters (Free Plus), Excel export and resend (Free Plus). An AI assistant may read entries only when an administrator turns on "AI assistants: access to entries" in Easy Form Builder's privacy settings; I do not edit or delete entries.

entries.title: Undo / redo, form versions, moving forms between sites
entries.answer: The builder has undo / redo (each AI change is one undo step) and keeps earlier versions of every saved form (Free 3, Free Plus 10, Pro 50) that you can restore. Forms move between sites as a form package; the export / import screens and the Contact Form 7 importer are in the free plugin "Easy Form Builder Data Tools". The forms I create go in through that same package, so Easy Form Builder runs its own checks on them.

entries.title: Inline validation, error summary and autocomplete
entries.answer: New forms check a field when the visitor leaves it, show an error summary with links, and (for several steps) warn before leaving a half-filled page; each field can carry an autocomplete token (name, email, street-address …) so browsers fill it. All on every plan.

entries.title: Localized name and address formats
entries.answer: Add a Name or Address from the palette and choose a format: names (full, first + last, with title, Arabic four-part …) on every plan; national address schemes (Iran, Saudi Arabia, UAE, US, UK, Germany, Japan …) are at the address field's level (Free Plus). A province list chosen with a fixed country is filled from Easy Form Builder's list service when it is added. Address search needs the Address & Postal add-on.

entries.title: Plans: Free, Free Plus and Pro
entries.answer: Easy Form Builder has three plans. Free covers the core fields and two steps per form. Free Plus costs nothing: a person activates it in Easy Form Builder's own upgrade dialog, and it adds a small public credit link on pages that show a form. Pro is paid. A locked feature opens Easy Form Builder's upgrade dialog, which names the plan it needs; I never change a plan.

entries.title: Step backgrounds and step style
entries.answer: Each step (or the whole form) can have a solid background colour on every plan; gradients are Free Plus; a different background on phones is Pro. Text colours can follow automatically for contrast.

entries.title: Pro renewal reminder
entries.answer: On a Pro subscription Easy Form Builder shows administrators a notice and sends one e-mail seven days before Pro ends, and a short note after it ends. I can tell you the end date when Easy Form Builder knows it; I never renew or pay. On a Persian (fa_IR) site Pro is a one-time purchase, so there is no renewal and no reminder.

entries.title: Features that are Easy Form Builder add-ons
entries.answer: Several features are Easy Form Builder add-ons: Numbers & Calculations, Typed Signature, Address & Postal, Visitor Country, Booking, every payment gateway, Conditional Logic, SMS and the CAPTCHA services other than Google. Install them from Easy Form Builder → Add-ons (a person's click; some need Free Plus or Pro). When a form needs a missing one I say which add-on and plan, use the closest field that works, and offer the install.

entries.title: Online payment gateways
entries.answer: Every payment gateway is an Easy Form Builder add-on: Stripe, PayPal (Free Plus), Persia Pay / ZarinPal (Pro), and Mollie, Payplug, Tap, Omise, PayTabs, Paymob and Xendit (Free Plus). The site owner enters the gateway's keys in Easy Form Builder → Payments; I can add priced options and the gateway field, but I never see keys, switch to live mode or refund. A form whose gateway is not ready shows visitors a notice instead of the payment field until it is.

entries.title: Export, import and the Contact Form 7 importer
entries.answer: Exporting and importing forms, bulk files and the Contact Form 7 importer are in the separate free plugin "Easy Form Builder Data Tools" (Tools → Easy Form Builder Data Tools). Install it from the WordPress plugin directory; I hand these tasks to it rather than copying forms myself.
